articleTitle: Enhanced Grid Frequency Stabilization with Renewable Energy and Virtual Inertia Support
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The virtual inertia control (VIC) methodology is presented in the given work for frequency regulation in interconnected test microgrid system. As power grids inertia deteriorated due to intermittent renewable energy sources. Therefore, it is required for operating reserved power plants to overcome voltage and frequency instability. The short-term suitable inertia control approach can alleviate this issue. Test area 1 includes the wind turbine generator, biogas plant, and biodiesel plant, while test area 2 contains the solar photovoltaic, biogas plant, and biodiesel plant along with VIC in each area. For the analysed micro-grid model, a modified type-II Fuzzy controller is proposed. A Quasi-Opposition based Harris Hawks Optimization (QOHHO) has been employed to optimal tune the various gains of deployed controllers. The improved system dynamic performance reveals the efficacy of the suggested VIC mechanism. The supremacy of the recommended regulation strategy is supported by the distinct improved outcomes.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of SVM-based ML Malware Detection Model Using Data Preprocessing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The exponential proliferation and speedy propa-gation of malware have been a major concern for computer users. Recently, Machine Learning (ML) is exploited as a sus-tainable solution to combat the increasing volume of malware. Despite its huge success in malware detection, the automated malware classification and detection system face challenges in feature representation and selection perspective. In this work, we investigate a support-vector-machine (SVM)-based machine learning (ML) model for malware detection systems. The focus of this study is to enhance the performance of the SVM-ML model by data preprocessing. Four different data pre-proceeding, transformation, outlier identification, filling and smoothing have been deployed on a standard portable executable header (PEH) classification of mal ware (CLaMP) dataset. The preprocessed dataset is used to train and test the ML model exhibiting an improvement of 7.95% and 3.19% of accuracy for the SVM Linear and Polynomial kernels respectively.

articleTitle: Detection of CKD from CT Scan images using KNN algorithm and using Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this paper a system model is proposed to ascertain Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) using Computed To-mography (CT) scan images and blood samples. The proposed system model is tested using a dataset of 400 patients. To annotate the CT/Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scan images, the edge detection technique is used in this paper. The system model is proposed considering four units such as edge detection, prediction, virtual assistant and book reader. Edge detection is an image processing technique that is used to identify points or edges in a digital image which are scanned images of CT/MRI. K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN) algorithm is used in this model for disease prediction. Further, virtual assistant and book reader is used to assist the doctor. The proposed model in this paper may be useful for doctor as well as patients for CKD detection. The Machine Learning (ML) approach proposed in this paper may save time and costs for diagnostic screening.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Dual Active Bridge Converter Operating In SPS And EPS Modes For Alleviating Solar Energy Intermittency In DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this paper the comparative analysis of Dual Active Bridge (DAB) converter working in extended phase shift (EPS) and single phase shift (SPS) control modes is presented. The DAB is employed to act as an energy exchange interface in the DC microgrid. The intermittency issue is one of the most important problems faced by the solar energy. The intermittency can be addressed by employing a suitable storage in the DC microgrid. The energy flow is controlled with the DAB controller. The control techniques (SPS and EPS) are employed with the help of a output voltage based closed loop controller. The DAB controlled in SPS and EPS control modes is tested in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Thirteen Level Boost Inverter with Low Switch Count
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Conversion of power from the renewable energy source to electric load requires power converters and multilevel inverter (MLI) plays a vital role in this segment. To reduce the number of switch counts, switched capacitor-based dc-ac multilevel inverter can be used. This switched capacitor-based inverter has fourteen switches with one input source and three capacitors. The peak inverse voltage (PIV) of nine switches is equal to the source voltage and the PIV is equal to twice the source voltage for the remaining four switches. This MLI topology obtains thrice voltage gain by using self-balancing capacitor and doesn't use any auxiliary circuit. To reduce voltage ripple and peak charging current, large capacitances are used. In the topology, high voltage gain with low switch count is achieved with PIV less than the output voltage. Simulation of this topology is verified with the proper result.

articleTitle: An Interactive Interface for Patient Diagnosis using Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Hospitals are the most common option for health checks, illness diagnosis, and treatment for sick people. This practice is followed by almost everyone in the world. But there is a drawback with this method of getting diagnosed. There are a lot of patients with various diseases/viruses which have a potential to spread in the hospital premises. People never considered the diseases/viruses present in the hospital atmosphere. People are aware of the risk of viral transmissions in hospital environments, post COVID era. Getting diagnosed and going through the reports with an efficient accuracy takes time and some people in emergency may not have enough time to perform the conventional procedures. Users have a necessity of an online website which can help them diagnose their health problems at the comfort of their homes. This would benefit people as they don't have to travel to the hospitals and reduce their risks of transmitting hospital acquired infections. This paper presents an interactive interface that functions as a virtual therapist which accepts input in the form of text, voice, or video. Data is pushed into the machine learning pipeline that generates results. The end result of this model is a report containing root cause of the disease, a tentative prescription, and any estimated treatment expenses. This model helps to prevent hospital-acquired infections, reduces the costs of treatment as users would be able to diagnose earlier and would prefer frequent testing, reducing surgeries and also reduces the tasks of doctors.

articleTitle: Lightweight Deep Learning Model for Weed Detection for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Increased crop productivity is largely dependent on weed control, thus making weed detection an important aspect of smart agriculture systems. To spray pesticides, it is necessary to distinguish between the weed and the crop. Owing to the recent advancements in Computer Vision algorithms and techniques, researchers have proposed numerous deep learning based pipelines for weed detection. However, deep learning is computationally expensive due to its dependency on power-ful GPUs (Graphics Processing Unit). This study attempts to tackle the problem of maintaining the trade-off between cost-effectiveness and performance of algorithms by utilizing You Only Look Once version 4 - tiny(YOLOv4-tiny). YOLOv4-tiny is a high-performance fast deep learning model that can run on machines with less computing capacity, providing farmers with a cost-effective IoT weed identification solution. Beginning with a literature survey on data collection, preparation, and model architectures, we propose the usage of YOLOv4-tiny for weed detection which is an object detection model and finally explain the deployment of our trained lightweight model on Raspberry Pi 4 Model B.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Crop Growth Parameters using Arduino and ESP8266
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: India is an Agriculture dependent country. With the significant percentage of its population depending on farming as their livelihood. Hence the monitoring of crop growth parameters is important for efficient yielding. This Project is regarding Smart Irrigation System by using Sensors. This smart irrigation system provides Automatic and remote monitoring of the fields. In this system we are using sensors like pH, Temperature, soil moisture, rain, Low-power image Sensors. The soil moisture sensor is used to monitor the moisture of the Soil. The temperature sensor will monitor the temperature level. The pH Sensor will check the pH range of the soil. Rain sensor is used to detect the rain. If the values which are measured hit the threshold value, a message is forwarded to the user's mobile number. Subsequently a relay can be activated to switch on the sprinkler water motor to wet the crops. An Arduino Uno is used as the brains of the system to interface with the sensors and IoT facility is provided using a Node MCU and Thingspeak. So, we are enhancing our project with an additional feature by measuring pH of our crop and soil with the help of pH sensor. By observing this pH values, we can monitor and control our land from crop failures. The conclusion of our project is to reduce the workload of farmer by saving his time, money, water usage and providing him a healthy and better proportion of crop yield.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Operation in Multilevel Inverter for More Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Electrical components have been adopted in place of hydraulic or pneumatic components on modern aircrafts, known as more electric aircraft (MEA). MEA emit lesser pollutants, has lesser weight, cheaper to operate and are quieter. For MEA, reliable power inverters that are capable of working in the electrical power system even after unexpected faults are highly desired. The major cause of faults in inverters is failure of power semiconductor devices and capacitor. Hence there is need of multilevel inverter (MLI) capable of tolerating faulty conditions and provides uninterruptable power supply to the loads. Such MLI is known as fault tolerant MLI (FT MLI). This paper discusses the operation of existing five level FT MLI under normal, and faulty conditions. The application of five level FT MLI for MEA is validated with simulation results.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation Of SPS Controlled Dual Active Bridge Converter For Alleviating Solar Energy Intermittency In DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this paper the analysis of Dual Active Bridge (DAB) converter working in single phase shift (SPS) control mode is presented. The bidirectional power exchange in the DC-microgrid with high power density is facilitated by the DAB. An output voltage based closed loop controller is presented in the present work. As the transformation ratio is different from unity so the efficiency of the DAB will reduce drastically. The optimum operating zone for DAB operation in DC-microgrid is obtained. The closed loop controller alleviates the load power intermittency and subsequently maintains a fixed load voltage. The proposed controller along-with DAB as a bidirectional in DC microgrid is verified in MATLAB/Simulink environment. The DAB is found to yield excellent results acting as a bidirectional energy exchanger.

articleTitle: Low Power 8T SRAM with High Stability and Bit Interleaving Capability
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: A new 8T Static Random-Access Memory (SRAM) presented in this paper. This paper addresses the issue related to power, delay and bit interleaving (column selection). The proposed design is compared and analyzed with existing 6T, 8T, 9T and SE8T SRAM. We can observe from the simulated results that the leakage power is minimized by 14% and 35% compared to SE 8T and conventional 6T SRAMs. It is observed that from the simulation results, the proposed design is an effective design for low power consuming applications along with high stability

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Diagnosing Wind Turbine Blade Fault Conditions using Rule Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The profligate-emerging wind trade has exposed a necessity for a further complex culpability analysis system in wind turbine sections. Current wind turbine research focuses on improving the eminence of their reliability and lowering the energy cost generation, mainly when wind turbines use in offshore locations. Wind turbine blades should be an essential module among the other principal sections in the wind turbine structure because they convert the active energy of wind into usable electricity. It is often destroyed due to environmental factors, resulting in a yield loss. The principal tenacity of the current research is to characterize distinct blade flaws by statistical metrics acquired from vibration signals. The Machine Learning(ML) method for classification includes attribute mining, proper attribute choice, and attribute taxonomy. The J48 methodology uses to select statistical characteristics from trembling signals recorded implementing the DAQ (Data Acquisition System). Then at last, the Decision Table, J Rip, One R, and Part Rules classifiers use to categorize characteristics. Other constraints need to calculate to estimate accuracy and performance evaluation by properly developing a prototype model to diagnose errors in a small interval. This technique is unusual since it uses Rule technique of ML to classify data from various wind turbine blade vibrations quickly.

articleTitle: Investigation Of Fault-Tolerant Capabilities Of a Reduced Device Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Having various applications of power electronics converters worldwide, the need for an efficient and reliable converter is vital to provide the uninterrupted power flow. Also, having a higher number of semiconductor devices is the most vulnerable part of the inverter. Because the switches are more prone to fault. Single switch open circuit fault may lead to disruption in the whole system; hence, for a multilevel inverter, fault tolerance capacity should be there without compromising the desired output of the inverter. This paper presents a novel fault-tolerant topology of a nine-level reduced device multilevel inverter to increase the reliability of an inverter, which itself has a demerit because of having less or no redundant state. Being able to tolerate fault in a vulnerable part of the circuit, that is, switches, makes it a better choice to opt for an application where power flow disruption is a major concern.

articleTitle: A Probabilistic Approach for Detecting Human Motion in Video Sequence using Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The detection and recognition of the human body in motion are two essential and demanding problems in visual surveillance systems. The detection process is slow and chal-lenging due to the dynamic nature of the background and the occlusion of moving objects. This paper presents a probabilistic approach to model the dynamic behaviour of the background and accordingly detect multiple moving human bodies in a video sequence. The Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) is used for adaptive background modelling. Blobs are drawn on the most significant and moving clusters of pixels in a binary image obtained after background subtraction to detect and track the moving humans. This simplified approach results in forming a pattern of various structural blobs. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach with many tests on the AVG- TownCentre and PETS09-S2L1 datasets. The detection speed of the proposed algorithm is 30 fps and 32 fps for AVG-TownCentre and PETS09-S2L1 datasets, respectively, have been recorded. Also, we have reported a less computation time of 3.8ms for the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Distributed Generation Framework using SWOT Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In a restructured power system environment, the distributed generation (DG) is one of the important assets to have as it can provide improvement in voltage profile, reliability, resiliency, reduction in losses, and costs. With increased concern about the environment, the use of DGs is a sustainable way for expanding the electric power generation to match the increased demand and help in electrifying rural areas. Depletion of fossil fuels, unpredictable fuel prices, and rising environmental consciousness have contributed to the rise in demand for alternative energy sources. The SWOT framework, which includes Strengths (S), Weaknesses (W), Opportunities (O), and Threats (T) variables, is used to identify and define the drivers and barriers for DG growth on a worldwide scale. SWOT analysis is used in this research to develop a DG framework that includes renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, hydro-power, and combined heat & power (CHP).

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Transformer-less Topologies for Grid-Connected PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: With solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, solar energy is converted into electricity with the least impact on the environment. PV Systems are a promising source of renewable energy. A PV inverter without a transformer includes many advantages, including high efficiency, high reliability, low weight, and low size. Leakage currents at such topologies, therefore, are unfavorable, so they must be eliminated. Inverter topologies with more semiconductor switches are a good way to eliminate leakage currents. The paper reviews analyze and compare several recent topologies published regarding renewable energy sources. A comparison is made among the topologies considering leakage current, semiconductor losses, and total harmonic distortion.

articleTitle: Analysis of Integrated DC-DC Converter-Based Grid Connected Transformer-less Photovoltaic Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The transformer-less inverter topologies have recently gained importance because of their small size, low cost, and low weight. The main issues in these transformer-less inverter topologies are to reduce common-mode leakage current with the increase in the transformation efficiency. In this paper, different conventional transformer-less topologies are discussed namely H4, H5, and H6 topologies. Unipolar modulation of H5 topology gives the best results. MATLAB/Simulink modeling of all the three topologies has been carried out and the results are shown.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of Distribution System Considering Protection Coordination
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Reliability of the distribution system is jeopardized due to a lack of coordination among the protective equipment. This study analyses the coordination between the fuse and the circuit breaker (CB) while evaluating the reliability of distribution networks. When there is a fault on the laterals, the main circuit breaker (CB_ m) must be opened, which degrades distribution network reliability and causes it to fail. In addition, the melting of the fuse during a temporary fault will raise the cost of repair. A fuse-saving scheme has been proposed in accordance with that. Petri net (PN) is being used to do a reliability analysis for coordinating purposes. The PN model provides a comprehensive understanding of the dynamic behavior of protection equipment as well as its coordination.

articleTitle: A Review of Non-Isolated High Gain DC-to-DC Converter Topologies
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Due to its unique properties such as cleanliness, noiselessness, and environmental friendliness, solar power has risen to become the most effective renewable energy source. DC-to-DC converters were given specific attention during the extraction of electric power due to their extensive use in several applications. In general, photovoltaic (PV) systems have a lower energy conversion efficiency and poor stability, and intermittent features. DC-to-DC converters can very useful for regulating DC voltage and increasing the efficiency of renewable sources of energy. An appropriate DC-to-DC converter selection is a critical aspect that has a considerable impact on the overall performance of power systems. Aside from choosing an effective DC-to-DC converter design, it's also critical to include an appropriate control approach for optimal operation. Due to the rising usage of RESs. Any step-up boost converter must have the same earthing between source and load, low voltage stress across semiconductor devices and high voltage gain at lower duty ratios are all requirements for any step-up DC-to-DC converter. In DC microgrids, DC-to-DC converters are commonly utilized to supply electricity to fulfil local demands.

articleTitle: EEG Classification For Stroke Detection Using Deep Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Stroke is currently a major public health concern. Hence more accurate and objective methods for diagnosis and prognosis are required to enable better clinical decision making. Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a non-invasive, low-cost method that can provide information regarding changes in the cerebral cortex throughout the recovery process following a stroke. EEG gives information on the progression of brain activity patterns. Many strategies have recently been developed to improve detection accuracy such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), Artificial Neural Network (RNN), Logistic Regression (LR), etc. VGG-16 and RESNET-50 are two non-invasive, low-cost transfer learning methods compared in this study. The results show that the proposed models can correctly classify EEG signals as stroke or not-stroke with 90% accuracy and 100% sensitivity for RESNET-50 while VGG-16 has a 90% accuracy, 100% specificity, and 100% precision. The work also compares other parameter i.e., F1-score between VGG-16 and RESNET-50 for this purpose. RESNET-50 is a major improvement over VGG-16 in terms of speed. Based on the results, this work appears to have been a success in terms of deep learning. Automation and great accuracy are achievable with this technique, which may be used in instances where Computed Tomography (CT) scans or Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examinations are not accessible.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Boost and Interleaved Boost Converter for PV Application
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Boost converters are significantly used in applications, including photovoltaic systems, uninterrupted power supplies, fuel cell systems, powered vehicles, etc. Essential characteristics of an efficient energy conversion process should include quality, reliability, maintainability, and reduction in the size of elements. Interleaving method is highly advisable for high-performance applications, where two or more identical converters are connected in parallel. This paper presents a performance comparison between standard boost-converter and two-phase interleaved boost-converter used for photovoltaic applications. Performance analysis is done using steady-state analysis and operation. A mathematical analysis of the different operating modes of each converter is also presented. The performance of the converters is validated using Simulink software. Current ripples on both sides, i.e., input and output have been reduced significantly. Interleaved boost converter implemented PV system has comparatively more minor ripples than standard boost converter implemented PV systems which tends to reduce losses and output filter size.

articleTitle: A Constant Current Charging approach for a lead-acid battery using the Cuk Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Environmental pollution, greenhouse gas emissions, and the scarcity of sources of renewable power have been among the major pressing concerns of the twenty-first century. For policymakers and global leaders, electric vehicles have emerged as a boon. A new generation of electric vehicle battery charging controllers needs to be developed to take advantage of the latest advancements in technology. The most important contribution of this paper is the study of the mathematical model and analysis of the Cuk Converter with a 12V, 9Ah lead-acid battery load. The design and observation of the combination of the converter, controller, and battery model give charging current characteristics of the battery at different SoC levels. The model controller parameters are optimized using GA algorithm, and their verification for a Cuk converter is carried out through MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Investigation to Improve Reliableness for Health Monitoring in Different Environments using MEMS based Higher Sensitive Microcantilever Array
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Enhancement of reliability and sensitivity plays a vital role in Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) technology, and it can be done very effectively by reducing the failures (through minimization) of such kind of systems. As it is a much known fact that using micro fabrication technique product development is not so easy because of its high cost and such facilities are not available everywhere. In this research work the primary focus is to know about the trust-worthiness of MEMS based devices by designing and performance analysis through simulation in multiphysics environment. The main outcome of this work is to model a novel device with high reliability as well as sensitivity which are very useful for healthcare monitoring and related applications in different environments. Through literature survey several reliability problems like stiction, fractural defects, immobilization, structural instability and many more has been noticed and possible solutions has been investigated which has been tested and analyzed in multiphysics environment. In this paper several micro-shapes and micro- structures has been designed and tested using different sensing materials but end of the result it has been found that microcantilever arrays are more useful and simple. Apart from this it has been also noticed that microcantilever has high reliability and sensitivity, it has been compared by applying some pressure to achieve maximum displacement. So, this research work is recommending microcantilever array sensor for different health care applications because of its high sensitivity, selectivity, high reliability, simplicity and versatility with different medium.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of RRAM Based Low Power NVSRAM Cell Designs for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The critical challenge facing engineers working on artificial intelligence today is overcoming the memory and power bottlenecks inherent in the present architecture to provide faster data access at a reduced energy cost. Non-Volatile SRAM (NVSRAM) based on embedded technology should provide fast access and energy savings. The Resistive Random Access Memory (RRAM) based NVSRAM technology will protect data in a power breakdown and secure data recall without consuming any power. Additionally, it incorporates the benefits of standard SRAM, such as high write speed, limitless cycles, energy efficiency, non-destructive data read, wear resistance, and a simple access protocol. RRAMs also called memristors have various benefits over other types of Non-Volatile Memories (NVMs), including compact device size, low voltage operation, fast speed, and CMOS compatibility. This study looks RRAM-based NVSRAM cells like the 7T1R, 7T2R, and 8T2R which bring non-volatility to SRAM cells. When compared to a standard 6T SRAM cell, simulation at the cell level demonstrates improved performance with better Read and Write operations at a compatible latency, improved noise margin, and reduced power. The simulation results show that the RRAM-based NVSRAM cell protects the data when power is turned OFF and retains the data when power is turned ON again, shows better stability, and has excellent switching performance during power on/off speed.

articleTitle: Speed Control of PV Array-Based Z-Source Inverter Fed Brushless DC Motor Using Dynamic Duty Cycle Control
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The development of advanced motor drives are primarily concerned with efficiency and reliability. Traditional motor drive technology is used in residential and commercial appliances such as refrigeration and air conditioning systems. A brushless dc motor has the advantage that its efficiency is high and also maintenance required is very low. The speed of the BLDC motor has been controlled with shoot-through Zero states by shorting one arm of the same leg of an inverter. The Z-source inverter system has distinctive properties that it can decrease as well as increase voltage levels by using its shoot-through zero states which is not present in traditional inverters. Here a dynamic duty cycle control is proposed to control the BLDC motor speed utilizing shoot-through zero states of the Z-source inverter. For commutation purposes, hall sensor signals are used. The modelled has been analysed and simulated using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Comparison of Control Techniques for a DC-DC Boost Converter Exhibiting Non-minimum Phase Behaviour
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: This paper is about comparion of three well known robust control techniques used for the regulation of output voltage for a dc-dc boost converter that has a non minimum phase characteristics. These methods are a two degree of freedom internal model control(TDF-IMC), cascaded active disturbance rejection control(CADRC) and proportional integral and derivative(PID) control. These methods have quite different control structure deign, such as IMC is a model based control while ADRC does not need the exact knowledge of the model. These methods have been implemented on boost converter and based on simulation studies settling time, integral absolute error(IAE) and peak overshoot/undershoot were calculated and compared. It was found that IMC method of control proved to be better than than the other two methods. This was proved on the basis of simulation results and the comparison parameters. From this comparison, it can be concluded that IMC scheme is better suited for dc-dc boost converter.

articleTitle: Optimal Generation Scheduling of Hybrid Systems using Manta Ray Foraging Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Load dispatch is an indispensable part of power system operation. Economic Dispatch (ED) and Combined Economic Emission Dispatch (CEED) are the standard complex contained benchmark used for accessing the potential of new optimization algorithms. The complexity of optimization problems has increased with time due to several factors like the type of generating units (dispatchable or non-dispatchable), their mathematical modelling (probabilistic or deterministic), internal characteristics (convex or non-convex), forecasted load demand and others. Metaheuristic optimization techniques have been able to handle these constraints appreciably due to their stochastic attributes. This paper attempts to explore the performance of a novel bio-inspired algorithm named as Manta Ray Foraging Optimizer (MRFO) for ED of a microgrid (MG) and CEED problems for a hybrid thermal solar PV system respectively. Both system considered for analysis have different scalability in terms of power demand. The performance of MRFO is compared with classical metaheuristic as well as new generation metaheuristic algorithms. Box plot analysis is also performed to compare the results statistically. Finally, it can be concluded that the performance of MRFO has outperformed the performance of other algorithms and has a future scope to entertain more practical and real-life engineering problems.

articleTitle: ANovel 17-Level Switched-Capacitor Multilevel Inverter with Reduced Device Count
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: This article presented a cost-effective 17-level voltage-boosting switched-capacitor (SC) inverter. To generate a 17-level staircase waveform, the suggested design uses twenty switches, four capacitors, and a single DC source. The series and parallel technique immediately resolves the capacitor voltage balance issue. The structure description, operating principle, computation of the optimal capacitance values, and modulation mechanism are all explained in brief. In terms of component per level factor, voltage gain, total standing voltage (TSV), blocking voltage, cost function, comparisons with the existing switched capacitor multilevel inverter (MLI) demonstrate the proposed topology strengths.

articleTitle: Malachite Green Detection Using Carbon Paste Electrode Based on Voltammetry
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The present work reports an easy and low-cost carbon paste electrode (CPE) for detecting malachite green (MG). MG has been extensively applied to control external fungi as well as parasites on fish-egg. However, MG is found to be terribly toxic and hazardous. Hence, in the interest of food security and citizens health, the determination of MG in aquaculture is very much necessary. The electrochemical behavior of the reported CPE electrode has been investigated by recording the corresponding cyclic voltammetry (CV) and differential pulse voltammetry (DPV) responses. These responses show that the presence of MG can be successfully determined using this electrode. The electrode can be utilized for detecting various concentrations of MG. The two different linear ranges of the response of this sensor are found to be 10–75 µM and 75–300 µM and repeatability and reproducibility are obtained with a relative standard deviation (RSD) of 2.28% and 2.38%, respectively. This electrochemical method can thus be chosen for the rapid detection of MG.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of MPPT based PV system: A case study
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In the present era, the world is gradually propagating towards the scenario where electricity generation is exceptionally reliant on sustainable power sources. The features, popularity, and utility of microgrids for future frameworks, to satisfy the consumer's electricity need, create interest among scientists and researchers towards sustainable energy. Solar energy can be utilized through Photovoltaic (PV) devices for the generation of electrical energy. The characteristics of PV power are nonlinear and its exhibition profoundly depends upon the sun-based irradiation and temperature. To solve these issues and achieve maximum power at any environmental condition we required a Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) Controller. There are various types of MPPT techniques for tracking the Maximum Power Point (MPP), from them most conventional and popular techniques are perturb and observe (P&O) and incremental conductance (INC). The INC-based MPP tracking algorithm is very convoluted, however having more proficiency than the P&O MPP technique at specified solar irradiance. Therefore, the fundamental goal of this present research is to perform a comparative analysis between INC and P&O-based MPPT algorithms under real-time irradiance data and figure out which algorithm provides the finest presentation in the particular climatic state of Dhanbad (Coal Capital of India). The case study has been done based on Hourly solar irradiance data of Dhanbad provided by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). MATLAB/SIMULINK environment is used to simulate the model and organize the results.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement and Sizing of Various C-Rate Type of BESS for Minimizing Reverse Power Flow in Radial Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: With the increasing worldwide large-scale integration of green energy resources, their variable output will mostly be influenced by local environmental conditions. Therefore excess high generation penetration of intermittent output generation of these DERs during some specific peak generation hours in a day leads to create problem of reverse power flow and over voltage, which is always been an important concern for power energy engineers which eventually increase the dependency on energy storage units. In this paper six different C-Rate types of batteries namely 0.5C, 0.08C, O.25C, 0.33C, 0.l67C and lC are optimally placed and sized using Teacher Learner Based Optimization (TLBO), to minimize the reverse power flow impact due to high penetrating intermittent DG output on hourly peak load variation. The results shows that by optimal evaluating BESS, voltage profile gets improved with active power loss reduction in a day. With the optimal located and sized BESS in distribution side of grid will leads to have a reliable with efficient grid support and reduced power loss help to grid load power demand diversification. In this paper Reliability test system model is used for the reliability analysis per hour for Modified radial IEEE 33 bus distribution grid network, and results are verified and simulated in MATLAB 2019b software.

articleTitle: Grid Interfacing for DC Microgrid using Three Level Diode Clamped Inverter by SVPWM Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The first stage of this two-stage grid-connected system contains a modified single-ended primary inductor converter (SEPIC) which acts as a boost converter and is used to track the Photovoltaic (PV) system's maximum power point using the perturbation and observe (P&O) technique. In the second step, a 3-level 3-phase diode clamped inverter converts DC to AC, which is then delivered to the grid. LCL filter reduces harmonic contents and hence total harmonic distortion (THD) gets reduced. The space vector PWM approach is utilised to control the inverter switches. The grid is regulated with the help of a synchronous reference frame PLL and a Proportional-Integral(PI) controller. The Simulation result of proposed methodology verifies that MPPT has been achieved and the sinusoidal waveform is obtained for grid connection. In the MAT LAB / SIMULINK environment, the proposed model is tested.

articleTitle: Control of Hybrid Electric Vehicle Speed by using Model Matching and Pole Placement Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this work, the throttle position of a nonlinear hybrid electric vehicle (NHEV) is adjusted by using a PID controller to achieve the desired speed. The controller settings are achieved by applying the concept of partial model matching and partial pole placement in the frequency domain. Model of the NHEV and the model comprising the desired specification given by the user are considered for model matching. The controller parameters thus obtained ensures uniform throttle opening thereby resulting in the desired zero steady state error and the required speed. The efficacy of the obtained controller is verified by performing the simulations under nominal, perturbed and noisy conditions. The simulation results shows supremacy of the suggested approach when compared with the recent works.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Triple Phase Shift & Extended Phase Shift in IBDC
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: An Isolated Bidirectional DC-DC Converter (IBDC) is used to interface between the various hybrid system and electric vehicles and nowadays its application is increasing day by day. These converters are mostly controlled by phase shift-controlled (PSC) topology. For enhancing the efficiency of IBDC many phases shift control topologies are introduced, in this paper, Triple Phase Shift (TPS) and Extended Phase Shift (EPS) are used to analyze the performance of IBDC by providing the phase shift (PS) in between the primary and secondary bridges of a high-frequency isolated transformer. From the obtained results, it is found that EPS produces less harmonics with a wider output voltage range as compared to TPS.

articleTitle: Game Theory based PV Array Reconfiguration Methodology to Enhance Shade Dispersion Factor under PSCs: Experimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) array performance is reduced by shading causes, which can be avoided using a variety of methods for changing the connections between PV modules. This paper suggests a method to reduce the impacts of partial shading conditions (PSCs) on solar PV arrays, through the traditional configurations like SP, TCT, and through game puzzle arrangements like Su-Do-Ku and Sky - scraper setups, to make a 9×9 size array. In this paper, an exploration into conventional electrical strategies, namely series-parallel (SP) and total-cross-tied (TCT), is compared. Furthermore, the suggested algorithm can be used to set up Photovoltaic panels to maximize power throughout non-uniform irradiation rates. The findings of study are evaluated on the basis of power loss (PL) and fill factor (FF). The responsibility of demonstrating the productive results of the envisaged PV array setup falls on careful monitoring. This paper is helpful for educationists and scholars who are looking for new ways to lessen the partial shading consequence on PV arrays in order to achieve higher global maximum power point (GMPP).

articleTitle: Image Based Recommender System using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Recommender systems have become extremely com-mon nowadays. These are used in various fields such as e-commerce, video streaming platforms, social media etc. Based on a person's previous history and taste, a person is recommended items. These recommender systems are software tools and techniques that are most commonly used by the companies to target customers. Traditional recommender systems use user feedback such as ratings, likes/dislikes etc to provide recommendations through various techniques such as Content Based Filtering, Collaborative Filtering etc. However there are many instances when a user has interacted with item but has not rated the same item. Also in many cases the rating data is mostly sparse i.e. either the rating is 0 or the rating has not been provided by the user, so the images of items that the users interacted with can be used to provide recommendations. Many e-commerce sites use this method for recommending items to users. In this paper we will be discussing an image recommendation system that can be used to recommend items only using images. It is implemented using transfer learning and cosine similarity, the system attempts to find a result nearest to the image interacted.

articleTitle: A Secure Medical Image Retrieval Technique using Encrypted Query Image
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In recent, electronic medical records of patients are frequently used and shared among several hospitals and medical clinics to make the medical records easily available to the medical professionals. The patient data contains private information about the individual patient so the database must be accessible to the concerned person in secured way. Relevant medical image searching and its retrieval are crucial in diagnostic and evaluation of suspicious signs to detect deadly and precarious diseases. Content based image retrieval (CBIR) is used for searching and retrieval of images based on the given query image but for the medical database security is also a vital issue so the medical professionals are responsible to retrieve and keep these records in a confidential manner. In this paper, the authors have suggested a model in which not only the retrieved result is secured through encryption process but also image retrieval procedure is carried out using the encrypted query image so that the patient information can be kept hidden from the image provider. The first level image encryption process is suitable to preserve the statistical information of the original medical image while the second level encryption process enhances the security and reduces the chance of cryptography attacks. The overall process is adequate to retrieve the images in secure manner.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Novel QOAOA Optimized Type-2 Fuzzy FOPIDN Controller for AGC of multi-area power system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The automatic generation control (AGC) of a triplet zone interrelated power system with different generation sources is discussed in this study, which employs an interval-type-2 fuzzy fractional-order proportional-integral-derivative with filter (IT2FFOPIDN) controller. The AGC mechanism attempts to restore the power system's nominal frequency after it has been exposed to load variations. Thermal producing unit, hydro unit, and gas unit are the control areas covered in this work. Nonlinearities like GRC, GDB, and boiler dynamics are employed in generating plants to produce power systems higher faithful and practical. A Novel-quasi opposition Arithmetic-optimization-Algorithm (AOA) is used for tuning the scaling factor and the membership function of interval type-2 fuzzy FOPIDN controller. To determine the efficacy of the proposed work, the dynamic response to step load disturbances is compared to existing controller methods.

Author Keywords: Type-2 fuzzy fractional order PIDN controller

articleTitle: Sensitive Electrochemical Detection of Carvacrol using Carbon Paste Electrode
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: A simple and affordable carbon paste electrode was developed to detect carvacrol. The spicy and strong odour makes it a useful ingredient for different types of species. Despite its many health benefits, carvacrol induces pro-oxidant activity if used in high concentrations. The electrochemical behavior of CPE has been explored in PBS6 buffer solution and the sensor founds to be sensitive. It responded linearly from 10 to 100µM, with a detection limit of 0.03µM. Oregano essential oil samples were analyzed using principal component analysis, which shows a good separability with an index of 1.473. This electrochemical approach can thus be used for the simple and rapid detection of carvacrol traces.

articleTitle: A Brief Review on Multi level Inverter Methodology Topologies and Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Multi-level inverters contribute to the industrial and research community due to the need in high power and medium voltage applications. It will be significantly better in case that the voltage level of the inverter exceeds the waveform. This type of inverter is capable of reducing harmonics and distortion. The multi-level converter is a method to generate high voltages from low voltages wave components. This paper discusses various topologies like Flying capacitor multi-level inverter, Cascade H-Bridge Multi level inverter and Diode clamped multi-level inverter that is separated from dc sources. Various types of switching schemes are also discussed in this paper.

Author Keywords: packed u cell mli and PWM techniques

articleTitle: Analysis of ECG Signal using Machine Learning Approaches for Detecting different Heart Abnormalities
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Electrocardiogram, a non-invasive recording of elec-trical potentials generated in heart is a popular method for capturing abnormal variations in cardiac activity. The abnormalities in the functioning of the heart are reflected in the ECG waveform and computer algorithms have been developed to detect some heart diseases using this ECG waveform. In this paper, a two-stage Support Vector Machine (SVM) approach has been proposed to classify four abnormal classes. In the first stage, SVM has been used to segregate ECG signals into normal or abnormal class. In the second stage, arrhythmia have been grouped in different categories using multi-class SVM. The performance of this scheme has been compared with classification accuracy obtained with convolution neural network. Additionally, classification accuracy has also been computed for four other classifiers. The overall accuracy achieved with two-stage SVM is 98.3 % and CNN 97.83 % respectively.

articleTitle: Pre-trained CNN Models and Machine Learning Techniques for Brain Tumor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: A brain tumor is a life-threatening condition that causes the brain's normal functions to be disrupted. For a definitive reading and an ef active treatment approach, brain tumors must be detected early. The physician's knowledge and experience determine a brain tumor's classification. However, an autonomous technique is necessary for rapid brain tumor analysis. The three extracting features algorithms VGG16, VGG19, and Inception v3 have been used in this study. Once the features were detected these are transferred to machine learning classifiers that distinguish between benign (non-cancerous) and malignant (cancerous) brain tumors. The results produce the highest accuracy of 97.7% using VGG16 and logistic regression classifier.

articleTitle: Identification of single and multiple partial discharge location within a power apparatus using Random Forest classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Partial Discharge (PD) detection and its estimation is a vital event for all the power equipment. Acoustic sensor based PD detection is more advantageous than the other available PD measurement technique. Acoustic PD detection technique has noise immunity ability to perform online partial discharge detection. In this work, a real life transformer model (RLTM) has been developed in the laboratory. Experimental procedure using acoustic sensor has been adopted to generate PD within RLTM. Several acoustic PD data have been acquired through acoustic sensors by placing the artificially created PD source at various locations inside the RL TM. Each of the sensor readings can be thought of as a waveform (time-series data) whose structure changes depending on the fault location. The novelty of the work lies in the fact that a number of features have been extracted using the Time Series Feature Extraction on Basis of Scalable Hypothesis tests (tsfresh- A Python Package) from the acoustic partial discharge data followed by classification using Random Forest classifier. Feature Selection is executed using Mutual Information Method. Percentage of identification accuracy for individual and coupled partial discharge sources are 94.4% and 91.5% respectively

articleTitle: Architecture of Automatic Irrigation System in Hilly Area using Wireless Sensor Network: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Without a proper irrigation system, agriculture is impossible. Earlier, the farmers are using traditional methods to irrigate their crops. Nowadays, scientists and researchers are working to develop new innovative techniques to properly irrigate the crop according to their requirement. In this paper our main goal is to use water efficiently in the hilly area mainly in the Per Panjanl range where water resource is very less. This purposed system based on the rooftop rain water technique to store rain water and use it for irrigation in these areas. This system powered through the solar system, battery, electric current etc. Our goal to be an optimal use of natural resources and use the water for automatic irrigation system so that the most of the barren area used for agriculture so that the crop quality and quantity can be enhanced. Our system is working on the parameter of the sensor which sense the temperature, soil moisture and humidity. These hardware components are connected to the NodeMCU perform tasks to the turn pump value on/off according to a predefined value in the sensor and their program.

articleTitle: Vehicle-to-Grid Technology for Microgrid Frequency Regulation Using DC Fast Charging Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) batteries can be used as potential energy storage devices in microgrids. They can help with the microgrid energy management by storing energy when there is a surplus (Grid to Vehicle, G2V) and feeding energy into the grid when needed (Vehicle to Grid, V2G). An appropriate infrastructure and control systems must be developed to realize this concept. A microgrid test system is modelled with a DC fast charging station to connect EVs. To show the V2G and G2V power transfer, simulation studies are carried out. The test results indicate that EV batteries can regulate the frequency in a microgrid utilizing G2V and V2G operating modes. The modelling result indicates that the EV combined with V2G technology can reduce grid frequency fluctuations.

articleTitle: Low Power and High-Performance Associative Memory Design
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Memory is an essential element of every VLSI circuit. This paper reviews Content Addressable Memory (CAM) and its conventional architectures. A model of CAM is proposed using a transmission gate (TG). The new design is proposed with 1-bit storing data. The performance of the proposed design is investigated in terms of the following parameters. power, layout area, power delay product (PDP), and transistors count. The design metrics of the circuit are compared at various technology nodes to understand the working better.

articleTitle: The HAAR-the JPEG based image compression technique using singular values decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: A combinational approach is devised in our paper for grayscale image compression. The suggested method exploits the features of Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), Discrete HAAR Wavelet Transform (DHWT) and Joint Photographic Experts group (JPEG). Firstly, the Image is compressed by discarding some singular values from the input image. In the second step, decomposing the image up to the first level using discrete HAAR wavelet transform and the approximation coefficients is considered only. Lastly, the JPEG algorithm is applied to get further compression. The newly devised method gives a better compression ratio with good image quality than other methods. Our proposed method produces a compression ratio of 24.74 and a PSNR value of 35.1574, which is higher than other existing methods.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement and Sizing of Various C-Rate Type of BESS for Minimizing the Impact of Intermittent DG Output on Hourly Peak Load Variation in Radial Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The motivation of contribution of renewable energy resources for national grid support are increasing by distribution utilities. The intermittent output behavior of these DERs during a day is always been an important concern for power energy engineers which eventually increase the dependency on energy storage units. In this paper optimal BESS placement and sizing is done by Teacher Learner Based Optimization (TLBO), for reduction of intermittent DG output impact on hourly peak load variation. Six different C-Rate types of batteries namely 0.5C, 0.08C, 0.25C, 0.33C, 0.167C and 1C are evaluated for voltage profile improvement with power loss reduction in a day. With the optimal located and sized BESS in distribution side of grid will leads to have a reliable with efficient grid support and reduced power loss help to grid load power demand diversification. In this paper Reliability test system model is used for the reliability analysis per hour for Modified radial IEEE 33 bus distribution grid network, and results are verified and simulated in MATLAB 2019b software.

articleTitle: Optimal Sizing of PV, Wind and Biomass based Grid Connected Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems for Rural Areas in Presence of EVs
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: This project intents to study the efficiency of the Hybrid Renewable Energy System (HRES) that comprises of solar, wind, biomass and battery. The study is carried out using the software viz. Hybrid Optimization Model for Electric Renewables (HOMER). This paper presents a thorough analysis of the different types of renewable resources connected to the grid. The study is based on the site of Siliguri in West Bengal. The area under study is 26° 43.6’N (lat) and 88° 23.7’E (long). The main purpose of this paper is to find an independent and reliable system in nature and at a reasonable cost of energy. The system analysed in this paper consists of two loads - a household load and a load associated with electric and rechargeable car chargers such as PV and Wind. HOMER aids in cost optimization and calculation of energy costs. By utilizing the NPC and COE, the best plan can be obtained and the right adjustments can be made. The development results show that a system that combines PV, Biomass, Converter and Grid is much better compared with Cost of Energy (COE) and Net Present Cost (NPC) system.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant step-down DC-DC converter for Aircraft applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Various control circuitries in an aircraft are housed on printed circuit boards. These control circuitries usually consist of microcontrollers or programmable logical devices to carry out execution of instructions based on various control parameters. The control circuitries are responsible for the smooth functioning of an aircraft and are responsible for various controlling actions such as fuel control, auxiliary power unit control, flight controls and navigation systems control. The programmable logic devices need to be supplied by a reliable power supply. As a failure in their operation could lead to catastrophic consequences. The power electronic circuitries involved in these power supplies contain semiconductor switching devices and they are vulnerable to failures. Hence an inherit fault tolerant capabilities of a DC-DC step-down converter is explored in this paper. This fault-tolerant converter provides more reliable operation than regular power converters for aircraft control and embedded system applications. In this paper, the authors have conducted literature survey, carried out a study and simulation of the aircraft electrical distribution system and then integrated the fault-tolerant converter.

articleTitle: Ransomware Vulnerability used in darknet for web application attack
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Cyber security is turning into a significant angle in each industry like in banking part, force and computerization segments. Servers are basic resources in these enterprises where business basic touch information is put away. These servers frequently join web servers in them through which any business information and tasks are performed remotely. Thus, clearly for a solid activity, security of web servers is extremely basic. This paper gives another testing way to deal with defenselessness appraisal of web applications by methods for breaking down and utilizing a consolidated arrangement of apparatuses to address a wide scope of security issues.

articleTitle: Knowledge Based Power Sharing in DC-Homes and Power Injection in Single Phase Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Solar PV sources is one of the abundantly available resource to the mankind. Nowadays, almost all the applications are integrated with solar PV for energy efficient design. In such a way DC-Homes are the future trending domain, in which almost all the homes will be powered by solar PV modules. In such cases, the power generated from the solar PV should be effectively used without wasting the conserved energy or the converted electrical energy. Hence, grid tied inverters emerged for integrating the solar PV with that of the utility grid. However, for low power domestic applications, grid tied concept will not work out due to the snags present in the complexity and harmonic distortions. This paper proposes a methodology of power sharing among the DC-Home units with lkW load and single phase 230V, 50Hz surplus power injection into a single phase grid. The proposed design and methodology is simulated in MatLab / Simulink and the prototypical setup is designed in hardware-in-loop with dSPACE MicroLabBox. The results obtained from the design validate the performance of the power sharing among the DC-Homes and power injection into grid.

articleTitle: A Cascade Fractional Controller for Hybrid Power System with Hybrid Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The Load Frequency Control (LFC) of compound power system is investigated in this paper under deregulation condition. The proposed system is divided into two areas. Area-l includes a thermal system, a biogas plant, Electric Vehicle (EV) and Dish Stirling Solar Thermal (DSTS) and Area-2 includes a thermal system, a biogas plant, EV and Wind Turbine System (WTS). The whole power generated by DSTS and WTS is fed to respective area. A modified crossbreed two degree freedom controller is considered. To improve controller gain, the Quasi Opposition Lion Optimization Algorithm (QOLOA) is applied. To damp oscillation in response of test system Hybrid Energy Storage (HES) is applied. HES consist of Redox Flow Battery (RBF) and Super Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES).

articleTitle: An Artificial Neural Network-Based Fault Detection Technique for PV Array
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: This paper presents an artificial neural network-based fault detection technique (ANNFD) to detect the short circuit fault (SCF) and hot spot faults (HSF) in PV array. The fault analysis is performed in the MATLAB-Simulink to identify the parameters which provide useful information on the faults. The pattern classification model of artificial neural network (PCANN) is used as a classifier to distinguish the SCF, HSF, and normal operating conditions. Various cases of faults are simulated under different irradiance, temperature, and fault resistance to validate the proposed methods. A sufficient number of training patterns is created through the simulation and used to train the PCANN. In addition, the optimal number of hidden neurons is determined on performance error evaluation. Further, the performance of the ANNFD is evaluated in terms of performance accuracy with the confusion matrix analysis.

articleTitle: Dielectric Pocket Nanotube Junctionless Field-effect Transistor based Biosensor
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this article, we present the application of Nanotube JLFET (DP-NT-JLFET) with embedded Dielectric Pocket as a biosensor with high sensitivity and selectivity, employing the technique of label-free detection of various neutral biomolecules as a sensing mechanism. The device is analyzed in terms of various parameters when target biomolecules are captured by the receptor in the cavity. The k-value of the biomolecules in the cavity is varied from 1 to 10 and its effect on drain current at different gate voltages is observed through a characteristic plot. The variation in threshold voltage and center potential of the device is also analyzed when the dielectric constant of the biomolecules is varied. OFF-state current is discovered to be the lowest when protein biomolecules of high-k is captured in the cavity, thus showing a higher I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf>/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf> ratio. The highest V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</inf> shift is also observed for a material with K=10 which shows a higher sensitivity for the proposed device.

articleTitle: ZnO-rGO-Ag Photoanode for Dye-sensitized Solar cells
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: To achieve appreciable power conversion efficiency, low cost and ease of fabrication, dye sensitized solar cell (DSSC) were invented. Components of DSSC are photoanode, cathode and dye. Photoanode plays an important role in DSSC. In proposed work the ZnO, ZnO-rGO, ZnO-rGO-Ag nanocomposites were prepared and implemented as anode material. The corresponding band gaps of 3.43 eV, 3.32 eV, 3.11 eV and absorbance of 344 nm, 356 nm, 378 nm were observed. The fabricated DSSCs were characterized under standard conditions and attained reasonable overall power conversion efficiency of 3.11%, 5.81%, 7.67% respectively.

articleTitle: Thermal Resistance Extraction of 14 nm SOI FinFET: A Machine Learning Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this work, A ML based thermal resistance extraction model of 14 nm SOI FinFET is proposed. Data sets for training and validation of model are generated from a well experimentally calibrated 14 nm SOI FinFET with the help of Synopsys TCAD FEM simulator. More than 1200 structures of SOI FinFET are created by TCAD simulations by varying the device parameters for datasets generation. Different regression models such as XGBoost, Random Forest Regression, and LGBM are used to predict the lattice temperature, and the outcomes of each ML approach are compared. Among the three models, XG-Boost yielded better results. This shows that integrating TCAD modeling and ML techniques for device parameter extraction lowers the computational cost for circuit designer perspective.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a Water Pumping System Powered by Induction Motor and a PV Array
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Poor electricity supply in rural areas is still the biggest challenge India is facing. Farmers usually depend on supply or diesel generators for electricity which in-turns contribute to pollution. This aspect, on the other hand, allows for more efficient use of energy. In the absence of a utility grid, photovoltaic (PV) array-aided water pumping devices are becoming more common in residential and agricultural applications. The Performance analysis of a Solar PV-based Three-Phase Multilevel-Inverter for a water pumping system is proposed in this paper. Solar PV Array is used to generate dc voltage regardless of different irradiance and temperature while collecting maximum power from the sun. Reduced Switch Count Multilevel Inverter is used to produce three-phase ac output from the dc, produced by solar PV. This three-phase AC output is used for running an induction motor-based water pumping system for different loads. The simulation was done in MATLAB and the obtained results are found satisfactory at different load conditions.

articleTitle: Palm Vein Image Processing and Enhancement in Vein Pattern Recognition System on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Biometric recognition systems based on hand vein patterns are gaining popularity because they have qualities such as universality, uniqueness, and fraud resistance. Veins are not visible to the human eye since they are positioned beneath the skin, they constitute a strong barrier against deception. The hand's complicated vascular pattern allows for the estimation of a useful number of characteristics for identifying individuals. It has a sanitary advantage over other biometric authentication systems because it is contactless. In a real-world environment, image processing is critical. It's employed in a variety of applications, including security systems, artificial intelligence (AI), and so on. The Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is the best-embedded platform for image processing applications. An FPGA's concurrent architecture allows it to do high-speed picture processing, allowing it to deliver timely warnings. Furthermore, modern FPGAs, particularly small-scale FPGAs, are very effi-cient in terms of cost and power usage. When compared to CPU execution, FPGA video/image computing delivers a processing speedup of ten times. This paper covered filtering approaches, contrast enhancement schemes and segmentation approaches. This paper demonstrates image enhancing techniques and then after results of these techniques are applied on vein images. We implemented an IP based embedded system because it is better in terms of power consumption, area and time. This paper has been work on reducing power as well as hardware utilization to design an optimized system since image processing requires extra hardware and power also.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement of Faulted Circuit Indicators in Radial Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The usage of feeder automation (FA) is increasing day by day among utilities for improving distribution system reliability. The FA includes fault detection, isolation, and service restoration (FDISR). FA mainly uses safety devices such as reclosers, faulted circuit indicators (FCIs), circuit breakers, and switches. The use of these devices ensures high-level reliability, at the cost of budgetary limits. This paper proposes a novel optimization model aimed to maximize the distribution owner's profit. The model described in this paper is based on cost-worth research. The acquainted model aims to place <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$FCIs$</tex> at optimal locations in the system. Utilities always try to maximize their profit in a deregulated and competitive environment. The proposed model uses mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) to bus 4 of the reliability bus bar test system (RBTS). The test findings support the suggested model's viability and applicability.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Power Flow Controller used for Solar PV based grid integrated system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: This paper presents an overview of different power control structures used for grid connected photo voltaic systems. First of all, various configurations for grid connected photovoltaic systems are discussed. After that control based on synchronous reference framework for three phase convertors to control the power injected into the grid is described in detail, simulation result is conducted in MTLAB/Simulink and the results are presented.

articleTitle: Loss Allocation in Three Phase Unbalanced Distribution Network Using Current Summation Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Being the weakest link in the power transmission system, loss in the distribution network (DN) is significantly large. The network users pay for their power consumption, and the losses in the distribution network remain unbilled. Loss allocation is an approach to allocating the network losses to the users according to their contribution to the losses. This paper proposes current summation-based loss allocation techniques for unbalanced three-phase four-wire DN. The current in the branches is expressed in terms of current injection by the loads. Allocation of cross-terms of current is calculated using quadratic relation between power flows and losses. The loss in phases, neutral and dirt corresponding to each branch is allocated separately to the contributing currents. The sum of loss allocation in relevant branches is added to compute the total loss allocation to the end-user. The proposed technique is tested on IEEE 13 bus test system. The results obtained are presented and discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Grid Tied Hybrid Microgrid for Hospital to Enhance Reliability and Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: With the development of new technologies in the field of medical science, continuous power supply is essential to run the modern life supporting equipment, especially when power outage occurs due to grid failure or any natural disaster. Usually, every hospital has their own diesel generator for providing emergency power back up. However, diesel generator has some limitations, like it may fail to start in emergency conditions. Further, power generated by diesel generator is not eco-friendly. Therefore, this paper developed a grid tied micro grid for a cancer hospital situated in Imphal, Manipur, India, considering actual load profile of the hospital for all the seasons. In this work, HOMER Grid software developed by NREL, USA, has been used to design a microgrid for the hospital. From the simulation results, it is observed that the grid tied micro grid comprise of solar photo voltaic, battery storage and diesel generator can meet the hospital load autonomously in case of grid failure. Further, this optimized system is reliable, cost effective and environment friendly.

articleTitle: An Efficient Salt and Pepper Noise Reduction Approach for Video(s) Using Optimized Filter Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In today's digital world, most information is shared through images or videos. Images and videos are more infor-mative than textual data. During the image or video capturing process, addition of noise is one of the major problems. The presence of noise in captured data causes results to be misleading, particularly in computer vision and image processing tasks. As a result, preprocessing is required before tackling tasks like edge detection, object detection, object recognition, salient object detection, video summarization, and so on. Gaussian, Salt & Pepper, Poison, and Speckle noise are the most common types of noise which can affect the video. In this article, the author(s) presented an efficient noise reduction approach for reducing the salt and pepper noise present in the image or video. The performance of the proposed approach is compared with traditional and widely used filters for noise reduction, such as mean, mode, and median.
