publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Over the last few years, fuel cells have steadily increased their share of power generation. No charging is required for fuel cells. The conversion of chemical energy from fuel to electricity can be improved by maximizing efficiency to ensure long-term production. There are currently five types of fuel cell technologies being researched. Stacks of Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) fuel cells are costly, making it hard to maximize their efficiency or make practical use of them. As part of the paper, a MATLAB/Simulink model of PEM fuel cell was developed to analyze its work in detail. By using this mathematical model, one can characterize a single PEM fuel cell in static conditions. Fuel cells are used to power DC motors as the primary energy source, and a controller ensures a uniform speed and output. PID controllers can be used to smooth out and stabilize the characteristic curve further. We developed a control regulation system for fuel cell applications based on the use of a PID controller.

articleTitle: Image Enlargement Technique Based On The Combination of SVD and Hermite Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The present paper proposes a simple method built on Hermite interpolation and Singular value decomposition (SVD) to enlarge images with the factor of less computational complexity. This approach also has the advantage that it is shifting the dimensions of the image from low to high while keeping the same content. SVD is applied to the three components of a color image to extract the information. Hermite interpolation has been then applied to the matrices obtained using SVD whose increment value is gained by optimizing the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The new information is attained using this increment value which has been utilized to resize the image. The proposed technique has been compared with the bilinear and bicubic interpolation by using entropy, spatial frequency, and standard deviations parameters to show its proficiency and applicatory.

articleTitle: Dielectrically modulated source side cavited SOI FET-Based Bio-sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this paper, we have designed and analyzed the application of fully depleted SOI MOSFET as bio-sensor by developing a source sided cavity below the gate electrode. Device design and simulation is done using Silvaco TCAD simulator. The performance analyses of the proposed biosensor is studied using threshold voltage sensitivity and ON state drain current sensitivity for cavity length of 40nm, 50nm, 60nm, 70nm. Considering the threshold voltage as sensing parameter, 50 nm cavity length is observed to exhibits better sensitivity compared to others. While considering the ON state drain current as the sensing parameters, 70 nm cavity length showed higher sensitivity. Further the sensitivity of the proposed bio-sensor is studied for different fill factor (50%, 75% and 100%), as expected the sensitivity for fully filled cavited device exhibited higher sensitivity.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis of EMG signals of the Healthy, Myopathy, and Low Back Pain Patients
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Electromyography is a technique of acquiring and recording a muscle's electrical activity; the electromyogram (EMG). This paper analyses the EMG signals of healthy, Myopathy, and low back pain (LBP) individuals taken from the PhysioNet ATM database. This work employs Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and statistical methods to analyze and compare the EMG signals of three different individuals. The results demonstrate a significant mean difference (p <0.05) between the three subjects' EMG signals. The RMS value of EMG data in LBP and Myopathy individuals compared to healthy individuals informs us that the muscle's electrical activity of a person with pain is higher than a healthy one.

articleTitle: Development of sensor for monitoring the integrity of the lubrication system of heavy duty pumps in nuclear reactors
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor(PFBR), heavy secondary sodium rotary pumps are provided with oil pots to collect the lubricating oil of the cooling system in case of minute leaks. These leaks need to be detected as early as possible. The Innovative sensor section(ISS) has developed a sensor with the electronics to detect the oil when it reaches a threshold level (5mm). The sensor can work accurately even above 100°C temperature. The added features of this sensor are it's robust nature and fail-safe model with very few random errors. The sensor has no moving or heating parts and a fast response time.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for Maximum Power Point Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this paper particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm has been presented for the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) method for photovoltaic systems under partial shading conditions. PSO is one of the bio-inspired algorithms. In this algorithm, only an objective function is needed and gradient and any differential form of the objects are not required. The performance of the proposed method has been verified with the help of several simulations carried out in a MATLAB environment for various shading patterns. Using simulation results, the performance and effectiveness of the PSO-based MPPT techniques are evaluated.

articleTitle: K - MRAS Based Mechanical Sensorless Vector Controlled PMSM Drive
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: This paper presents position/speed estimation for PMSM (“Permanent- Magnet- Synchronous- Motor”) drive. Speed estaimated method are important to build the drive more reliable, reduce cost and be fault-tolerant. Among all the methods for estimating speed, MRAS (Model Reference Adaptive System) has been selected for its simplicity and simplicity in implementation. Two equivalent fictitious quantities are formulated and used in MRAS's adjustable and reference models. Actual currents and reference voltages in dq-axes reference frame are used for estimation of speed and position. The proposed method is independent of integrator, differentiator, and stator resistance. The presented method is validated in MATLAB/ SIMULINK platform, and some of the outcomes are presented here.

articleTitle: Design of an Expert System by Combining PDC and FDS Data for Condition Assessment of Transformer Insulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Dielectric properties of the power transformer insulation system change during the transformer's life. In recent years, both Time Domain Spectroscopy (TDS) and Frequency Domain Spectroscopy (FDS) techniques have gained popularity for the condition monitoring of transformer oil-paper insulation. To access the condition monitoring of transformer insulation, various performance parameters are calculated. These performance parameters calculated from a single measurement technique may not give accurate results due to the complex aging process of transformer insulation. The present paper represents the design of an expert system by combining TDS data and FDS data. The expert system introduces the combination of different measurement techniques in the time and frequency domain. An optimized Debye model of transformer insulation obtained from the expert system can calculate the performance parameters for the condition monitoring and diagnosis of the insulation system. Unlike a single diagnostic technique, the expert system can entirely assess the insulation condition as it does not depend on a particular type of measurement technique and is less likely to be influenced by the error of any other measurement technique. So the expert system can provide reliable and efficient information for the diagnosis of transformer insulation.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Organic Solar Cells Using Multiple Diodes
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Organic PV cells have been the center of interest in recent years because of the benefits of having customized molecular characteristics and cost-effective manufacturing techniques. Precise simulation of organic photovoltaic cells has become increasingly crucial as rigorous and quick research is applied to organic photovoltaic cells. In this paper, various models to simulate an organic solar photovoltaic cell are being discussed. The modeling is done through integral circuit equations, unlike any other complicated mathematical model accessible in the literature. These models can also simulate the ideal and non-ideal current-voltage characteristics of an organic solar PV cell. The primary goal is research towards investigating the performance of organic solar cells and developing a precise PV model that can accurately recreate the I-V characteristics. A comparative study of the different diode models is also included.

articleTitle: A Simplified Space Vector PWM Technique of Three-Level Diode Clamped Inverter with Rectifier Side Direct Power Control Topology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Multilevel inverters are the dominating power electronic converters nowadays, can provide bulk amount of applications in industrial drive control and grid integration of renewable energy sectors. In this work, the implementation of a specialized, simplified three level space-vector PWM topology of three level diode clamped inverter with an additional rectifier on source side is described. A two stage AC to DC (full controlled rectification) and DC to AC (full controlled inversion) conversion is used in this scheme. A conventional DPC technique is used on the rectifier side control topology to mitigate the source current harmonics, to maintain the unity power factor operation at source side as well as to control the DC link voltage. A three-level Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) technique has been used at inverter side, while Direct Power Control (DPC) technique has been used at the rectifier side. In the inverter side a three-level SVPWM technique has been used to mitigate the Total-Harmonic-Distortion (THD) of inverter end voltage. A comparative analysis of harmonic distortion of inverter-side voltage is carried out with various multicarrier PWM control techniques available in literatures. Rectifier side DPC has provided a THD of 3.95% and inverter side three level SVPWM technique provided a THD of 14.79%, hence this overall scheme with DPC-SVPWM combination can be directly applied in grid integration of variable speed wind energy conversion system as well as in industrial drive control applications.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Grid-Connected PV System Using Flyback Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Among all renewable energy sources, photovoltaic (PV) conversion is one of the most popular research disciplines. In many levels of power conversion, power electronic converters play a vital role. The harvesting of solar energy utilizing an interleaved flyback converter with an isolated single-phase grid integration is presented in this study. The interleaved topology leads to enhanced power level, current ripple reduction, fewer passive component requirements, and reduced switching stress. The overall system has been designed in a two-stage structure: DC-DC power conversion by three-interleaved flyback converters and DC-AC conversion using a single-phase full-bridge inverter. The DC-DC stage is controlled using two conventional maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms: perturb and observe (PO) and incremental conductance (INC) methods whereas a sinusoidal pulse width modulation is used to control the DC-AC stage. A comparative analysis of the two different MPPT algorithms has been presented considering various performance indices such as dynamic performance, tracking performance, total harmonic distortion (THD) in grid current as well as grid synchronization using a phase-locked loop (PLL). The grid-connected PV system model is developed in MATLAB-Simulink and performance is analyzed through simulation results.

articleTitle: A Cascade Fractional and Fuzzy Controller for Hybrid Power System with FACTS Device
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The Load Frequency Control (LFC) of a compound power system is investigated in this research under deregulation conditions. The test system is divided into two areas, each of which includes a thermal system, a biogas plant, Distributed Generation (DG), and an Electric Vehicle (EV). The HVDC line is utilized to improve tie-line power transfer capability. Frequency regulation is accomplished using the HVDC energy that has been stored. A crossbreed fuzzy and three degree freedom controller is considered. Uncontracted load is going to be handled by EV. To improve controller gain, the Quasi Opposition Lion Optimization Algorithm (QOLOA) is applied. Static Series Synchronous Compensator (SSSC) is used to improve transfer capability of AC tie-line.

articleTitle: A SOGI-AQSG-Based Control Technique for Improving Power Quality in Unusual Grid Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this work, A three-phase microgrid based on a Second Order Generalised Integrator-Adaptive Quadrature Signal Generator (SOGI-AQSG) is implemented to improve the power quality of the system under unusual grid circumstances. The solar PV generating system have a major influence in meeting the energy needs at the distribution end. Numerous challenges arose in the process of transmitting energy from the source to the load. The primary goal is to keep the power factor close to unity, which may be achieved by meeting the load's reactive power requirements. Majorly the non-linear load adds harmonics to the system. Power quality issues resulting from nonlinear loads may be effectively addressed by the presented SOGI-AQSG control. The system's effectiveness is tested in MATLAB/Simulink software under Sag/Swell, varying irradiance and under changing load. Overall, the IEEE-519 2014 norm is maintained.

articleTitle: Parallel-in-time Simulation of Automatic Generation Control System Using Multi-Step Adams-Bashforth Numerical Solver
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to investigate fast tran-sient simulation of automatic generation control using multi-step Adams- Bashforth numerical solver. Namely, four and six steps Adams-Bashforth method is considered. With aid of OpenMP library in ‘C’, we observed that execution time has improve remarkably.

articleTitle: A Simple Setup For Temperature Study Of Humidity Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The humidity sensor behaviour at high and low ambient temperature is always a matter of great interest. However, the role of temperature is critical to understand the sensor behaviour. The study of temperature effect is challenging because of its repercussion on humidity level present inside the test chamber. In this work, a simplified and cost-effective scheme is proposed to expose the sensor at different temperature as well as humidity. The designed test chamber facilitates the localized heating of the sensor without altering the humidity level inside the chamber. To study the effectiveness of testing chamber, a sol-gel based, ϒ-Aluminium oxide sensor with interdigitated structure has also been utilized. Further studies and experiments have been conducted at different Relative Humidity (%RH) and temperature. The experimental results are in well agreement with the theoretical observations.

articleTitle: Behavioral study of characteristics of physical parameters of Janus colloids and Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this paper, the behavior and characteristics of physical parameters of Janus colloids such as sedimentation speed and self-propulsion speed varying with the orientation angle have been studied. The characteristics of detachment or desorption energy with an average of varying contact angles of different types of Janus Nanoparticles, which are being considered for stability and interfacial rheology at fluid interfaces (such as oil/water interfaces) have also been studied and all these are understood through computer-aided simulations.

articleTitle: In roads to OPV Design Perspective: Limitations & optimum parametric characterization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Organic photovoltaics (OPV) is an emergent phenomenon which combines transparency, flexibility, weightlessness and sleek design for solar modules. The reported efficiency for lab manufactured OPV are approaching 20%, with reported life varying from some months to several years. Still, the path towards successful commercialization of this technology is a long way ahead. In this article, we discuss the various factors which limit the efficiency and life of OPV.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of APA, JO-APA, VSS-APA, and VR-APA for Acoustic Echo Canceller
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Well-known normalized least mean square (NLMS) algorithm for system identification problems, does not provide a satisfactory convergence rate while dealing with correlated inputs. So, for the applications such as acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) where signals are highly correlated and have echo path of long duration, algorithms that can provide a better convergence rate and low misadjustment are preferred. In this paper, performance comparison of affine projection algorithm (APA) and its variants have been studied for AEC application. Simulation results for APA, joint-optimized APA(JO-AP A), variable step-size APA (VSS-AP A), and variable regularized APA (VR-AP A) at different values of projection order have been obtained. Based on the simulation study it is found that JO-AP A provides a better convergence rate while maintaining lower misalignment specifically at the higher values of projection order.

articleTitle: Dielectrically Modulated both-side cavited SOI-MOSFET based Bio-sensor highly sensitive for glucose oxidase
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: We propose an SOI-MOSFET-based bio-sensor with cavities on both sides, i.e., source and drain, in this paper. The sensitivity of a bio-sensor is evaluated by looking at the change in threshold voltage and drain current that occurs when bio-molecules are introduced. The cavities etched under the gate oxide are of one symmetrical and two asymmetrical types. The asymmetrical topology having 50nm source side and 20nm drain side cavity exhibits higher threshold voltage and drain current sensitivity for glucose oxidase. Glucose oxidase is an enzyme which is synthesized by interaction of species like fungi and micro insects. It helps in detection of glucose and could also be used for detection of diabetes and Alzheimer disease. The sensitivity of this device is also tested for different filled factors such 50%, 75% and 100% and it is observed the sensitivity for fill factor below 100% is very low. The device design and simulation results for different variations are obtained by using Silvaco TCAD simulator.

articleTitle: SMIB Power System Dynamic Modeling and Simulation with TCSC Using PSO
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In terms of improving the power system's stability, this study describes a method for designing, simulating and fine-tuning the variables of such a Thyristor Controlled Series Compensator (TCSC) controller. The TCSC controller design challenge is framed as an optimisation problem, then Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used to find the best TCSC controller settings. The system's stability is improved by minimising a time-domain dependent objective function that encompasses the generator's asynchronous rotor speed variation.

articleTitle: Energy Management of a Coordinated Neighbourhood Area of Smart Households with RES
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In current home energy management system energy trading among the neighbourhood consumers is not explored much. Along with this all users receive the same price signal from the utility therefore it is a tendency to operate their appliances during low price periods which causes unnecessary peak and hence system instability issues. These issues may be resolved by neighbourhood energy management system. So, in this paper, energy management of neighbourhood area is done to minimize the total energy consumption cost using time of use and real time pricing schemes that schedule the appliances. Decentralized coordination technique is used to coordinate all users as well as the utility grid. In this, each user has a photovoltaic panel with a different capacity and gives their preferred durations to run their appliances. Users first use self-generated power and if they have surplus energy or energy deficit, they can exchange it with their neighbours or the grid. Finally, the energy scheduling problem is solved using mixed integer programming optimization technique with the CPLEX solver of GAMS software.

articleTitle: Discrimination of Thymoquinone Using Near Infrared Spectroscopy Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The present work represents the discrimination of four samples of thymoquinone (TQ) using near infrared (NIR) spectroscopy. Thymoquinone (TQ) bears anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, anti-viral, immune-modulatory, anti-microbial and anti-coagulant activities. Thymoquinone (TQ) is found as an active ingredient in black seed oil. The scanning range of NIR transmittance spectrum was selected from 900 nm – 1700 nm. To distinguish various TQ samples, raw NIR spectral data was used for clustering using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) method. The plot provided successful clustering of the four different samples where PCA1 explained 88.04%, and PCA2 explained 3.89%. Ten different replicas of data were taken into consideration for further analysis. Initial observations indicate that proper discrimination any food stuffs can be done using NIR spectroscopic technique.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Capacitive Type Quasi-digital Sensor and Instrument to In-situ monitoring of the viscosity of Lubricant Oil
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Lubricant oil is used as protective layer between the metallic surfaces of gears and bearing of large rotating machinery for smooth operation of power plants and other heavy industries. Viscosity of lube oil plays an important role in reducing friction between rotating parts. Over the period of time, due to oil aging, its viscosity decreases along with deterioration in its various physical and chemical properties. Timely replacing of lube oil at critical viscosity level set by industry standards with fresh one can avoid the potential damage to the rotating machinery and unplanned shutdowns. This article presents development of a capacitive type quasi-digital sensor for real time measurement of lubricant oil viscosity. In addition to sensor an instrument is also developed to read the output from the sensors, to communicate the data to computer, and display on LCD. An experiment is conducted to check the capability of the sensor and instrument for measurement of lubricant oil viscosity. The sensitivity of the sensor is 232Hz/m. Pa.s, and the accuracy is ±10 m.Pa.s. A python based Graphical User Interface (GUI) is also developed to plot real time viscosity and temperature graphs by collecting the sensor data from COM port of the PC.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Control of Advance DC-DC Converters for BLDC Motor Driven SSWPS
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this paper, the design for control and implementation of standalone solar water pumping system (SSWPS), using speed control of BLDC motor drive which is being fed from SPV array via advanced DC-DC converters (ADDC's), namely Luo, single-ended primary-inductance converter (SEPIC) and ZETA converters have been carried out. For achieving the desired performance of BLDC motor, there is an immense requirement of proper speed controller and an input supply having low ripple value. Thus, by integrating PI controller with an ADDC, an attempt has been made to implement a better speed control system considering BLDC motor drive. The specifications of the controller have been fine-tuned to optimize motor performance. The modeling and performance using comparative analysis for studying the effectiveness of the intended system is authenticated by carrying out a relative simulation study in Matlab/Simulink software.

Author Keywords: incremental conductance maximum power point tracking (INC-MPPT)

articleTitle: Prediction of Mortality from Heart Failure using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) or heart failure (HF) is a vital cause of death worldwide. Approximately 17.9 million people die each year, and it accounts for 31% of global deaths in India as well as across the world. HF has become one of the most life-threatening diseases that is commonly caused by CVDs. When treating patients, it is critical in medicine to make the proper judgments in a short amount of time. Given the large quantity of data generated by the healthcare sector, ML technologies play an essential role in predicting CVD. In this work, various ML-based algorithms are applied to a heart disease dataset to predict the mortality of patients from HF. A comparative analysis of the models based upon various performance measures (accuracy, precision, and recall) has been done. Finally, ensemble learning is used for the prediction of mortality from HF with an accuracy of 90%, -achieved on the test data.

articleTitle: A Spider Monkey Optimization Based Global Maximum Power Point Tracking Technique for Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: This paper presents a new global maximum power point tracking (GMPPT) scheme for solar PV system. The presented scheme is based on the swarm intelligence operated optimization known as Spider Monkey optimization (SMO). The paper starts with a broad overview of various techniques of maximum power point tracking (MPPT) which are applied to the photovoltaic (PV) system. All the techniques have their own advantages and disadvantages. Many extensive researches have been done in this arena and many new techniques have been developed in recent years. Researches are still going in the area to get the method that would have the maximum efficiency and all the benefits of various techniques combined. Here, we discussed a few of them. In this paper, we have reviewed, analyzed and compared the various techniques. Moreover, the paper presents the working of SMO-GMPPT, its flow, the Simulink model description and the results obtained. The results show that SMO-GMPPT is capable of tracking the true global peak during partial shading phenomena, it is fast and true GMPPT method.

articleTitle: Flag-based Human Supervised Robot Guidance Using Locality Preserving Projections
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: With the deployment of collaborative robotics in industrial and domestic applications, intelligent robots are anticipated to work with humans in dynamically challenging daily life environments. Robots must deal with several photometric and spatio-temporal complexity in the workspace to achieve successful human-robot collaboration. To overcome these issues, especially in the case of vision-sensor-based systems, several robustness and adaptability measures need to be incorporated. One of such could be the adaptation of a concise and distinctive feature extraction tool for information-rich, high-dimensional data such as locality preserving projections (LPP). The locality information of the original higher-dimensional data is encoded and preserved in that weight parameter unlike principal component analysis (PCA) and linear discriminant analysis (LDA). This can be very much useful in real-life vision-sensor-based systems where the intrinsic locality structure of the images carries significant information. This paper proposes an LPP-based solution for a real-life human-supervised robot navigation guidance system. The proposed approach outperforms contemporary feature extraction techniques like PCA.

articleTitle: A Review on Hybrid Electric Vehicles and Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Complete transformation of conventional vehicles into Electric Vehicles is quite a challenging task due to limitations such as infrastructure, high cost and lack of general public approach. Hybrid Electric Vehicle provides a pathway to complete hybridization of vehicles which will help to mitigate vehicle emissions and reduces consumptions of fossil fuels. Current research and development in the core components of HEVs like storage system, power train and brushless DC motor provides a good opportunity for complete hybridization of vehicle. Governments of developed and developing countries have taken many initiatives to shift from conventional vehicles to hybrid and electric vehicle. This paper provides an overview of hybrid electric vehicle from the primitive stages of development to the current scenarios along with their source of power. The description of components of HEVs, historical aspects, challenges and possible solutions are also holistically presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Machine Learning in Sports Talent Identification: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Sports talent identification is drawing an increasing research interest from the academic community. The traditional approaches are being systematized into the scientific approaches. The scientific approaches project an analytical understanding of the Talent Identification and Development (TID) process. This paper reviews the work done in this field from 1996 – 2021. We have reviewed the articles in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines. We trace the computational procedures that have evolved with time, for the sports talent identification. The special focus has been given to the role of machine learning in Cricket Talent Identification. The review delivers and discusses some key findings.

articleTitle: Application of Multilevel Inverter in Power Generation Using Renewable Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The generation of electricity from renewable energy sources like the sun, wind, and hydrothermal is growing increasingly common as demand grows. Renewable energy systems are attaining much more consideration in present times and most nations are attempting to put themselves out of the dependency on conventional energy resources. An increase in demand from the high power sectors also made an increment in demand in a power grid. Power electronics are an important component of solar energy, and the demand for efficient power electronic converters is growing. Researchers are increasingly interested in multilevel inverters over two-level inverters because of their ability to deliver improved efficiency and higher DC link voltages. The paper explains the MLI based on their application, development, and demands with practical recommendations for utilizing them in renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: ANFIS-Controlled Voltage Source for Vigorous Speed Control of BLDC Motor Drive for Utilization in Smart Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Technology is advancing at a very fast pace newer and better types of machines are being evolved. Initially, we had the DC motor but now we have a new generation of DC motor called brushless DC motor (BLDC). This has all the advantages of a dc motor with none of the disadvantages like commutation loss or sparking due to the commutation process. In this paper, we have devised a way for speed control of BLDC motor. The research is not limited to only tracking a single reference point but a fast-changing set of references. This is done to simulate real-life conditions where an electric vehicle that uses BLDC motor for mobility as on roads, we are certain to face sudden speed changes so the speed control system should be robust to be able to undergo such changes. Here we have used two types of controllers for controlling the voltage input to the motor. This includes a PID controller and a new improved which has a combination of both neural and fuzzy i.e., ANFIS controller. Transient response characteristics of both the controlling system are compared. A quasi-iterative process is used for tuning PID parameters. In conclusion, we can see that the ANFIS controller is better because it is easier to implement and has robust convergence characteristics. For simulation purposes, we have used a permanent magnet synchronous motor with a change in the back-emf waveform from the sinusoidal to the trapezoidal waveform.

articleTitle: A Hybrid System with Number Plate Recognition and Vehicle Type Identification for Vehicle Authentication at the Restricted Premises
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Vehicle detection and number plate recognition approaches have been widely studied in recent years due to their wide applications. In this research paper, we propose a framework to ensure the entry of authorized vehicles in restricted areas such as the University campuses, townships, etc., where we are expecting the entry of a set of authorized vehicles. Certainly, unauthorized vehicles might be allowed to enter those areas after proper verification by the concerned people responsible for ensuring security. In the proposed approach, the admin should register all the authorized vehicles in a system with the essential attributes such as vehicle number, type, etc. A surveillance camera placed at the entrance will capture live videos. When there is a vehicle in the camera view, the image frames will be passed to an automatic number plate recognition module. The number plate recognition module will identify the same, and it will be matched with the details in the database to authorize the vehicle. This manuscript proposes a real-time and reliable approach for detecting and recognizing license plates based on morphology and template matching. To ensure the reliability of the system, a frame selection module will select the image frames with high quality, and even to improve the number plate recognition accuracy, the image will be enhanced using image enhancement techniques such as histogram equalization. The image enhancement techniques will help to provide better results even though the videos are taken with low lighting conditions. Further, we ensure that the vehicle type matches the number present in the database to prevent unauthorized access using fake number plates. The experimental study is conducted using videos taken under various environmental conditions such as lighting, slope, distance, and angle.

articleTitle: Modeling and EMT Simulation of Renewable Energy Sources using HYPERSIM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: With the rapid increase of distributed energy resources, it is essential to determine and examine its impact on the whole power network. In the RT simulation environment, plants and controllers can be analyzed before being implemented into an existing design. The article presents modeling and electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies of a system consisting of renewable energy sources in a network in an RT environment by HYPERSIM. Various studies like changes in irradiation, steady-state operation, variation in wind speed, and LLLG fault have been done in the RT simulator. As a result, grids of the future will be based on high-power electronics and distributed power systems. Proper blocks with an effective symmetry between simplification and detail are proposed to depict the nature of these components. RT blocks allow the dynamic nature of power electronics within the time frame. This work depicts the electromagnetic transient RT blocks of high-tech energy conversion systems which include photovoltaic power plants and wind power with a Type IV controller. The performance of each block has been examined using transient simulations.

articleTitle: Biomarker Design Using Combinations of Upper Back Muscles to Classify Chronic Neck Pain During Curvilinear Walking
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: In this study, a biomarker is designed to detect chronic neck pain (CNP) using electromyography (EMG) signals during curvilinear walking. Only 19 time-domain features from each EMG signal of 40 participants (20 asymptomatic, 20 with CNP) have been used in this study. A Neighborhood Component Analysis (NCA) approach has been used to determine the most significant features with the highest discriminative power for conducting the diagnosis. Then Support Vector Machine (SVM) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) are used to process selected features, resulting in acceptable accuracy compared to previous research works in this field. The SVM-NCA model has gained the best classification performance for all combinations of different muscle groups. Using a combination of four muscle groups, the NCA-SVM-based model with only 15 features has obtained the best classification performance (accuracy: 97.5%, sensitivity: 100%, specificity: 95%, precision:96%). While With 17 features, this methodology has yielded the best classification results using a combination of three muscle groups (accuracy: 97.5%, sensitivity: 95%, specificity: 100%, precision:100%). However, the best performance for two muscle group combinations has been achieved with 18 features (accuracy: 95%, sensitivity: 90%, specificity: 100%, precision:100%).

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Solar PV system for a Remote Village using MPPT Algorithm Based on Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic (PV) frameworks are becoming more popular for generating electricity for remote areas. This is because solar energy is plentiful. Since India's location is best for harnessing solar energy, the government is taking various initiatives to utilize the available solar energy by promoting various schemes efficiently. Moreover, India has yet to reach 100% electrification of remote areas, which might be hindered due to technical, social, or economic constraints. So, this article proposed the design of a PV system for a cluster of household load demand in a remote village known as Tiwaripur. Additionally, the DC-DC boost converter architecture design process with a comprehensive mathematical formulation is also presented in this work. Further, maximum power point tracking strategies are utilized to enforce the PV system to work at its best capacity by considering the adverse conditions, such as partial shading circumstances. Lastly, a comparison is made between the two well-known optimization algorithms, Cuckoo Search (CS) and Flower Pollination Algorithm (FPA), to track the optimum power point of the PV framework.

articleTitle: Estimation of Insulation Condition Sensitive Parameters from Polarization Current using DFA
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Polarization and Depolarization Current measurement technique is a popular technique used for the condition assessment of Power Transformer insulation system. The assessment is usually done by identifying Debye model parameters from the measured polarization current data. However, obtaining the Debye model parameters involves complex computation and the model parameters are also dependent upon the number of branches in the model. Hence, in the present work, a Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (DFA) based method is proposed for the estimation of insulation condition sensitive parameters of the oil-paper insulation system. It was observed that one of the DFA coefficients maintain well-defined relationships with the Insulation condition sensitive parameters: dissipation factor, paper moisture content, polarization index and dielectric absorption ratio, which shows the applicability of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Impact of COVID-19 on Sustainable Development Goals in India
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has expanded all over the globe in a short span of time. It has created a colossal impact on the environment leading to severe consequences. Since March 2020, India has witnessed untold misery and suffering when millions of people have been hit by virus. The pandemic poses both enormous problems as well as several opportunities for the countries to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) set out according to the agenda by the year 2030. The SDGs consist pragmatically of different aspects of humans and their environmental well-being, and achieving it will provide ecology with a stable and sustainable life by maintaining the health of our green planet also. It has been damaged by a devastating blow due to Covid-19. The pandemic is bound to have consequences that will have an impact for years to come. The continuous decline in the economy of India with inclination in COVID-19 cases has resulted in an uneven track to fulfilling, meeting, and delivering the SDGs by 2030. The devastating impact on all 17 goals has already endangered the achievements made earlier. COVID-19's effects have highlighted the fundamental need for human well-being. This paper exclusively highlights the SDGs in India which have faced or likely to face an impact due to pandemic and the roadmap for future action to achieve Agenda 2030. This research will also help in understanding the effect of the pandemic on SDGs at state level as in countries around the globe. The paper would open a wide area of research for policymakers to strengthen the SDGs in line with the current pandemic situation.

articleTitle: Architecture for using Machine Learning for Prediction of Pneumonia disease through Clinical Symptoms
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Pneumonia is the biggest cause of death in children below the age 5 years, as well as the main source of death worldwide but mostly in developing countries. The detection of pneumonia is usually done by highly-trained doctors looking at a chest X-Ray radiograph. This is a time-consuming process that frequently results in radiologists disagreeing. Clinical-aided techniques showed promise in terms of increasing diagnostic precision. There was no single clinical characteristic that was sufficient to definitively diagnose pneumonia. The novel point of test care for the treatment of bacterial pneumonia can help to reach a sustainable amount of correctness, but adding clinical characters in a decision tree would improve treatment result. We use clinical symptoms like compress and vanishing deep twist machine learning, supplementations, and also we use aggregate learning to construct a computational strategy for detecting pneumonia in children. Early diagnosis can decrease the death rate in children. The WHO criteria for diagnosing clinical pneumonia are applied for the precision.

articleTitle: Computer-based Sentiment Analysis to Solve Real-world Societal Problems and Its Challenges
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Due to evolution in every sector around us, a large amount of information is generated at every moment. In recent years, many microblogging platforms have become the primary place for the public to express their mood. So the sentiment analysis data collected from websites, reviews, and feedback can be used in many areas such as in marketing or product analysis or competitive research for future development. So, sentiment analysis is one of the booming domains, a study of analyzing people's reviews, suggestions, feedback from the text format and checking if the data shows positive, negative, or neutral emotion. Applications of sentiment analysis are endless and are applicable in every social domain. We can automatically assess the tone of internet interactions using natural language processing and machine learning methods. Sentiment analysis can be performed with the help of various techniques, depending on how much data needs to be examined and how precise the model needs to be. This manuscript is a comprehensive article that includes all the essential topics related to sentiment analysis, such as its applications, challenges faced and various algorithms.

articleTitle: Review of Advancements in Forecasting-aided State Estimation based on Kalman Filter Approach for Voltage Profile of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Forecasting-aided state estimation (FASE) is per-formed for power system to help in monitoring and control of the system. The estimation is carried out employing the data from remote terminal units along with that from phasor measurement units. So far for FASE, it is assumed that the variations in the system variables, for instance load demand variations at a bus are slow. Quick variations in the states of an electric grid are hence not included for the study. To predict the states at a time instant in between receiving the two measurement datasets from the measurement system, a state forecasting approach is being used. The filtering step is carried out with the help of a Kalman filter approach. This aids in the estimation of power system states during periods when field data are unavailable.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithms for Efficient Workflow Scheduling in IaaS Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: Cloud computing is a novel way of delivering resources over the Internet. Cloud computing, albeit a newer computer paradigm, has many obsolete predecessors. In addition, it is so popular that it doesn't need taxonomies to define. Our early study looked at the origins of cloud computing and their significance to cloud services. Many applications in research and industry have made workflow scheduling in cloud computing popular. Several articles have proposed using the heuristics method to account for energy savings, cost, and makespan. However, most heuristics or hybrids methodology does not provide near-optimal solutions. Therefore, we examine the limitations and potential advancements of cloud computing workflow scheduling technologies. The objective is to develop time and cost-efficient heuristic and hybrid workflow scheduling methods. Finally, we discuss and propose strategies to overcome impediments to the growth, application, and development of cloud computing.

articleTitle: A Novel approach of MPPT with Soft Switching Converter Interface
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Emerging Frontiers in Electrical and Electronic Technologies (ICEFEET)
abstract: A new method for measuring maximum power point (MPP) for photovoltaic (PV) systems is suggested in this paper. This approach is based on the particle swarm optimization (PSO) technique. This algorithm has a wide step length range which results in a very high response time to changing ambient condition. This method is based on analog and thus no DSP and/or A/D are employed in this system which greatly reduces the complexity and cost. To further increase the total efficiency, a soft switching converter as an interface circuit is applied. All semiconductor devices in this converter are fully soft switched. The proposed system is analyzed and the simulation results arepresented. A 500W Simulink model is implemented.
